questions.q: Which desert city ruled by Queen Zenobia challenged Rome?
questions.why: Its ruins are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which Muslim dynasty made Damascus its capital in 661?
questions.why: The Umayyad Mosque is its legacy.

questions.q: Which country ruled Syria under a mandate after the First World War?
questions.why: Syria became independent in 1946.

questions.q: Which Kurdish sultan who fought the Crusaders is buried in Damascus?
questions.why: His tomb is next to the Umayyad Mosque.

questions.q: In which year did the Syrian civil war begin?
questions.why: Millions were displaced.

questions.q: Which Crusader castle in Syria is one of the best preserved in the world?
questions.why: The Knights Hospitaller held it.

questions.q: Which ancient city on the coast developed one of the first alphabets?
questions.why: Its cuneiform alphabet had 30 letters.

questions.q: Which queen of Palmyra declared independence from Rome in 270?
questions.why: Emperor Aurelian defeated her.

questions.q: Which 1958–61 union joined Syria with Egypt?
questions.why: Syria left it in 1961.

questions.q: Which family ruled Syria from 1971 until December 2024?
questions.why: Bashar al-Assad fled to Russia in December 2024.

questions.q: Which ancient kingdom's archive of clay tablets was found at Ebla?
questions.why: About 17,000 tablets were found.

questions.q: Which Roman emperor was born in Syria and built a grand city at Shahba?
questions.why: He ruled from 244 to 249.

questions.q: Which city's huge medieval citadel stands on a hill?
questions.why: Aleppo soap is also famous.

questions.q: Which Syrian city is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world?
questions.why: It has been lived in for thousands of years.

questions.q: Which old market in Aleppo was one of the longest covered souqs?
questions.why: It was badly damaged in the war.

questions.q: What is the capital of Syria?
questions.why: It is called the 'City of Jasmine'.

questions.q: Which river crosses northern and eastern Syria?
questions.why: The Tabqa Dam forms Lake Assad.

questions.q: Which sea lies along Syria's west coast?
questions.why: Latakia is its main port.

questions.q: Which 'dead cities' in the north are abandoned Byzantine villages?
questions.why: They are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which Roman theatre city in the south is built of black basalt?
questions.why: Its theatre is one of the best preserved.

questions.q: Which saint is said to have converted on the road to Damascus?
questions.why: Straight Street in Damascus is linked to him.

questions.q: Which great mosque in Damascus dates from the early 700s?
questions.why: It has beautiful golden mosaics.

questions.q: What is Syria's currency?
questions.why: It is also called the lira.

questions.q: Which olive-oil and laurel soap comes from Aleppo?
questions.why: It has been made for centuries.

questions.q: Which giant wooden water wheels turn in Hama?
questions.why: Some are over 20 m tall.

questions.q: Which covered souq in Damascus leads to the Umayyad Mosque?
questions.why: Its roof is pierced with bullet holes from 1925.

questions.q: Which red pepper and walnut dip is from Aleppo?
questions.why: It is sweetened with pomegranate molasses.

questions.q: Which pastry with cheese and syrup is popular in Syria?
questions.why: It is topped with pistachios.

questions.q: Which Syrian poet's 'Bread, Hashish and Moon' made him famous?
questions.why: He was born in Damascus in 1923.

questions.q: Which castle on the coast is named after Saladin?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.
